cases.defect: Only one playable screen exists while the declared journey requires more states.
Final UI is flat HTML/SaaS-style chrome without game identity.
Runtime assets are non-uniformly scaled or arbitrary crops are used as nine-slices.
Actors and feedback do not read at actual runtime scale.
A later asset batch uses a different palette, camera, material, or detail language without a style-version change.
Text, ornaments, focus rings, or controls overlap or clip at a required viewport.
A required action, focus path, pause, restart, or recovery control is unreachable.
Temporary tones or missing mix coverage are presented as final audio.
Evidence is stale, outside the project, self-authored, unhashed, or not produced by the declared command.
A declared failure/interruption path cannot recover, retry, continue, or exit safely.
A shipped asset or dependency lacks commercial rights/provenance.
A current target build violates its declared frame-time, memory, loading, or stability budget.
